definitions.explanation: A reflective surface for seeing one's image.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っている→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: My face is reflected in the mirror.

examples.japanese: {鏡|かがみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れて→割れる：00907_wareru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、{鏡|かがみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えて→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: In the morning, I fix my hair in front of the mirror before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{鏡|かがみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{着|き}てみて→着る：00541_kiru⟧、⟦うれしそうにしていた→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I bought new clothes and happily tried them on over and over in front of the mirror.

notes:
{鏡|かがみ} refers to a mirror — both ordinary household mirrors and mirrors with cultural or symbolic significance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鏡|かがみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look in the mirror
- {鏡|かがみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映|うつ}る→映る：12964_utsuru⟧: to be reflected in the mirror
- {鏡|かがみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in front of the mirror

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{手鏡|てかがみ}→手鏡：16020_tekagami⟧: hand mirror
- ⟦{姿見|すがたみ}→姿見：15876_sugatami⟧: full-length mirror
- ⟦{鏡餅|かがみもち}→鏡餅：19469_kagamimochi⟧: stacked rice cakes for New Year
- ⟦{鏡開|かがみびら}き→鏡開き：25599_kagamibiraki⟧: breaking open the New Year rice cakes (or sake barrel)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Mirrors are one of the three sacred treasures of Japan (⟦{三種|さんしゅ}→三種：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神器|じんぎ}→神器：noentry⟧), symbolizing wisdom and truth.
